description: Final evaluation set for the KnowYourRules Telangana assistant: 120 questions. Expected behaviour is derived from the indexed knowledge base (snapshot 20261117T123454Z-a5d03a2afe: Central MV Act extract, MVDR 2017, Telangana MV Rules, GOs) and the 162 Telangana Police e-Challan website rows (backend/echallan_fines_data.json). e-Challan amounts are website-displayed, unverified figures, not statutory penalties. 'expected_behavior' is what the sources support; 'acceptable_alternatives' are other outcomes that would not be wrong. Evidence ids are e-Challan row ids (W… wheel-wise table, P… plain table) and manifest_id::provision for statutory text. Nothing here has been legally reviewed.
